newsitem.title: USA: World Bank lends $14.5 mln for Turkish healthcare.
newsitem.headline: World Bank lends $14.5 mln for Turkish healthcare.

text.p: The World Bank on Wednesday approved a $14.5 million loan to help finance a healthcare project in Turkey, the bank said in a statement.

The World Bank said its loan would finance 78 percent of the total project, which aims to improve primary healthcare in the provinces of Bilecik and Eskisehir. The Turkish government would pay $4.1 million of the project.

"The project will provide a framework for reducing regional and gender disparities in the health status of the population and will strengthen health care managerment," World Bank project task manager Brad Herbert said.
